name: Motion Lab Production Specification (project.json)
purpose: JSON Schema (v2) for projects/<slug>/project.json: template, style system, delivery formats with sizes and safe areas, fps, duration, quality, timing source (narration, music or fixed), audio settings (narration optional, licensed music, SFX, captions, loudness target) and runtime version. Projects without project.json remain legacy single-format explainers.
capabilities: Machine validation for multi-format project configuration
Aspect-ratio aware delivery (16:9, 9:16, 1:1) with safe areas
Explicit audio decisions instead of narration-by-default
approval_evidence: v2 rewritten 2026-10-30; validated against projects/masala-chai-recipe/project.json and template project files. v1 was not referenced by any project file.
